title: dispsa-fixed-point: code and data for 'A two-step inertial S-iteration algorithm with Tikhonov regularization for common fixed points and forward-backward splitting, with applications to image deblurring and data classification'
description: Code, data and stored results that reproduce the numerical experiments of the paper 'A two-step inertial S-iteration algorithm with Tikhonov regularization for common fixed points and forward-backward splitting, with applications to image deblurring and data classification' by Suthep Suantai, Bancha Panyanak, and Kobkoon Janngam. The scripts regenerate Tables 1 and 3-8 and Figure 1 of the paper (split feasibility problem, image deblurring, breast cancer classification, ablation study).
